title: QI Shard Saver – Round 1 (Slow)
subtitle: Slower, shard-conscious opening · Convert before Round 2+
intro: A slower Round 1 settlement plan focused on conserving shards before converting to a boosted army layout and moving to Advanced QI Settlement in later rounds. Follow the 14 collection stages in order. Building counts and balances are taken from the supplied community document; actual results vary.

pages.title: Initial build / Collection 1
pages.description: Start with 3 QS expansions and 1 goods expansion. Build 27 multistorey houses and 25 estate houses with the 670k starting coin budget. Starting balance: 0 coins, 295k supplies, 0 alloy. For the first collection, progressively collect and sell multistoreys and estates, temporarily replacing them with churches to raise happiness. Sell churches. Build 2 shoemakers, 24 multistoreys and 25 estates. Return after 1 hour. Source balance: 2.3M coins, 245k supplies, 141 alloy.

pages.title: Collection 2
pages.description: Collect and sell houses in stages while building churches for happiness. Sell remaining estates and replace with 6 multistoreys and 1 mansion. Build 12 breweries, collect shoemakers, then sell churches, breweries and mansion. Build 6 shoemakers, 18 multistoreys and 22 estates. Return after 1 hour. Source balance: 3.9M coins, 313k supplies, 67 alloy.

pages.title: Collection 3
pages.description: Use the same staged collection and church-happiness cycle. Sell all but 4 estates and add 5 multistoreys. Build 6 breweries; collect shoemakers; sell churches and breweries. Build 10 shoemakers, 1 ropery, 14 multistoreys and 15 estates. Return after 1 hour, then build 2 rope expansions and 8 estates. Source balance: 4.5M coins, 287k supplies, 151 alloy.

pages.title: Collection 4
pages.description: Collect houses in stages with churches, then sell churches. Build 1 rope expansion. End with 4 multistoreys, 8 breweries, 2 doctors, 14 estates, 10 shoemakers and 1 ropery. Source balance: 5.0M coins, 201k supplies, 661 alloy.

pages.title: Collection 5
pages.description: Collect all. Build 1 rope expansion. Sell multistoreys and add 2 clapboard houses (instant finish), 16 estates, 10 breweries, 10 shoemakers, 2 doctors and 1 ropery. Source balance: 4.4M coins, 391k supplies, 196 alloy.

pages.title: Collection 6
pages.description: Collect all. Build 1 rope expansion. Sell 5 estates and build 3 clapboard houses (1 new, instant finish), 3 doctors (1 new), 1 mansion (new), 12 breweries (2 new), 11 estates, 10 shoemakers and 1 ropery. Source balance: 4.9M coins, 621k supplies, 981 alloy.

pages.title: Collection 7
pages.description: Collect all. Build 1 rope expansion and sell ropery. Sell 5 estates and 1 brewery; build 4 clapboard houses (1 new), 2 bakeries (new), 3 doctors, 6 multistoreys (new), 6 estates, 11 breweries and 10 shoemakers. Source balance: 5.4M coins, 762k supplies, 661 alloy.

pages.title: Collection 8
pages.description: Collect all. Sell 3 estates and build 3 more clapboard houses. Source balance: 6.5M coins, 1.5M supplies, 276 alloy.

pages.title: Collection 9
pages.description: Collect all. Sell 5 shoemakers, all estates and 2 multistoreys. Build 1 mansion (new), 8 clapboard houses (1 new), 13 breweries (2 new), 5 bakeries (3 new), 1 beekeeper (new), 4 multistoreys, 5 shoemakers and 3 doctors. Source balance: 7.7M coins, 2.9M supplies, 21 alloy.

pages.title: Collection 10
pages.description: Collect all. Build 3 honey expansions. Sell beekeeper, last 5 shoemakers, mansion and multistoreys. Build 9 estate houses (new), 17 breweries (4 new), 8 bakeries (3 new), 1 cannon camp (new), 8 clapboard houses and 3 doctors.

pages.title: Collection 11
pages.description: Collect all and train 300 cannons. Sell cannon camp and 1 estate house. Build 10 gunpowder manufactories (new), 18 breweries (1 new), 8 bakeries, 8 estates and 8 clapboard houses. Source balance: 7.2M coins, 936k supplies, 5,876 alloy.

pages.title: Collection 12
pages.description: Collect all. Build last goods expansion using gunpowder. Sell gunpowder manufactories. Build 9 estate houses (1 new), 2 cartographers (new), 19 breweries (1 new), 8 clapboard houses, 8 bakeries and 3 doctors.

pages.title: Collection 13
pages.description: Collect all. Source balance: 12.7M coins, 5.4M supplies, 17,766 alloy. Prepare for the final settlement conversion.

pages.title: Collection 14 / Conversion
pages.description: Collect all. Sell all houses and supply buildings. Build 30 doctors, 9 cartographers, 48 gargoyles and 2 nautical statues, adjusting the exact mix to your available supplies, alloy and boost needs. The source suggests an alternative conversion at collection 13 if no boost is required: 2 pillories, 38 doctors and 4 cartographers. This is the transition point before moving to the other advanced approach.

credit: Based on the supplied QI_ShardSaverXiarmy.docx community guide. Original creator attribution should be retained or added when known.

title: Beginner Version 2 · Faster Finish
subtitle: Higher-stat beginner route · Intended to finish earlier than the slow shard-saving plan
intro: A faster beginner-oriented alternative based on the supplied “z Qi Eng” guide. Suggested for players with around 75% QI attack stats; this percentage is a user-provided target, not a verified minimum. The guide itself stresses having QI attack buildings. This approach can use shards for expansions and optional speed-ups, so it is not the cheapest route. Follow the source-page images and the attempt instructions below.

pages.title: Overview & layout
pages.description: Requires QI attack buildings such as Forgotten Temple, Tourney Ground, Yuki, and Baroque/Osbian Tower. Ascended buildings such as Snowdrop Garden help. Each 6x6 area fits nine 2x2 houses or four 3x3 buildings.

pages.title: Attempt 1 · Initial build
pages.description: Open 3 shard expansions for a 3x5 tile; clear rocks if necessary. Build 7 Estate Houses, 1 Mansion, 1 Multistorey House, 2 Churches, 6 Tanneries, 6 Breweries and 9 additional Multistorey Houses. Donate goods and fight easy nodes.

pages.title: Attempt 2 · Church swaps
pages.description: Replace 9 Multistorey Houses in sequence with 4 Churches (remove 4, then 2, then 2, then 1); wait 5 seconds between builds. Harvest approximately 400 alloy and other resources. Remove Churches; build a Catapult, buy 30 soldiers and delete it. Rebuild 9 Multistorey Houses. Replace 2 Tanneries with 2 Shoemakers.

pages.title: Attempts 3–4 · Build alloy
pages.description: Attempt 3: repeat the 9-house to 4-Church swap; wait 5 seconds between builds; harvest about 596 alloy; replace 2 Tanneries with Shoemakers. Attempt 4: harvest about 792 alloy; delete 5 Churches, build 1 Doctor and 9 Multistorey Houses; replace 2 Tanneries with Shoemakers.

pages.title: Attempts 5–7 · Expand and fight
pages.description: Attempt 5: perform Church swap; harvest about 1,000 alloy; build Ropery and purchase 3 expansions, waiting 1 hour or optionally using 25 shards to speed up. Build 4 Frame Houses, 3 Churches and Multistorey Houses. Attempt 6: harvest about 1,400 alloy; buy a rope expansion and delete Ropery; add 2 Frame Houses and a Cannon Camp, noting resource limits. Attempt 7: reach 150% Euphoria before harvest; aim for 1,700 alloy; add Doctor, Clapboard House and decorations, then buy Cannons. Later: build toward 2 Bakeries and 2 Clapboard Houses; collect ~13,000 alloy, 6m coins, 5m supplies, buy 200–300 Cannons, then rebuild toward 18 Doctors and 20 Groups of Trees.

credit: Based on the user-provided z Qi Eng guide. Its original diagrams and instructions are preserved in the page screenshots.

title: No-Stats QI Build — 13 Collections
subtitle: Updated 13-collection walkthrough · One image and instructions per collection
intro: Original screenshot pages with written instructions and city layouts. Begin with setup, then follow Collections 1–13 in order.

pages.title: Starting Setup & Assumptions
pages.description: Start with a weak ASF, 0/0 QI stats and a one-week city. Donate goods in goods mode except rope; expect to donate at levels 1–3.

pages.title: Collection 1
pages.description: Collect tannery, replace with churches to build happiness. Collect multistoreys, replace with churches to maximise happiness. Collect the rest. Build 1 shoemaker and check back in an hour. Buy 2 QS shard expansions. Fight after the guild 100% node unlocks, or donate surplus coins.

pages.title: Collection 2
pages.description: Collect tannery and replace with church. Collect multistoreys and replace with churches; use estates if needed to reach maximum happiness. Replace as many estates as possible with breweries. Collect shoemaker. Build 3 more shoemakers; return in an hour and finish rebuilding as shown.

pages.title: Collection 3
pages.description: Follow collection sequence: multistoreys → churches for max happiness; estates if needed; estates → breweries; collect shoemakers. Build 1 ropery and 3 more shoemakers; buy 30 goods expansion. Fill remaining space with 16 multistoreys and estates. Allow QAs to accumulate (guide estimates ~5,000 per collection), or donate/fight if practical.

pages.title: Collection 4
pages.description: Follow the same happiness, brewery and shoemaker collection sequence. Buy 60 goods expansion. Build 1 shoemaker, 1 doctor and 1 trebuchet camp.

pages.title: Collection 5
pages.description: Follow the same collection sequence. Build 1 tower of ruins / group of trees (depending on colour), 2 doctors and 30 trebuchets.

pages.title: Collection 6
pages.description: Follow the same collection sequence. Buy 1 clapboard (rushed) and 90 goods expansion.

pages.title: Collection 7
pages.description: Follow the established collection sequence. Build 2 clapboards (rushed), 30 trebuchets and 1 more decoration (tower ruins / group of trees). Fill remaining space with tanneries rather than estates.

pages.title: Collection 8
pages.description: Build 1 clapboard (rushed) and 1 bakery (rushed). Buy 130 goods expansion, add 1 decoration and build trebuchets until 70 are in inventory.

pages.title: Collection 9
pages.description: Build 2 more clapboards (not rushed) and buy 1 more goods expansion.

pages.title: Collection 10
pages.description: During collection, convert tanneries to breweries to boost bakeries. Buy 310 goods expansion. Delete all shoemakers and build 4 bakeries (rushed). Build 2 more clapboards (not rushed) and 1 decoration.

pages.title: Collection 11
pages.description: Follow collection sequence: maximise happiness with houses, then convert tanneries to breweries. Buy the final goods expansion, delete ropery and build 1 more decoration.

pages.title: Collection 12
pages.description: Collect all, following the established collection sequence. Build additional trebuchets as desired; otherwise no further changes.

pages.title: Collection 13
pages.description: Flip the whole town and follow the collection sequence. Build 300 trebuchets and 16 doctors, plus decorations as shown. The source notes up to 500 trebuchets may be possible with surplus supplies; plan the town flip accordingly.
